question: Which compound structure includes a saturated short-chain fatty acid with 4-carbon molecules, commonly found in esterified form in animal fats and plant oils?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Butyric acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Butyric acid (C4)** is a saturated** short-chain fatty acid **comprising four carbon molecules, commonly present in esterified form within **animal fats and plant oils**.
 
• Alongside **acetic (C2) and propionic (C3) acids**, butyric acid ranks among the most prevalent saturated
